_source: https://www.islemaps.com/map/map-light.png + map-dark.png (2500x2500, single Leaflet imageOverlay; site bounds [[-616,-560],[618,674]] in cm/1000 with lat = -gameX/1000)
_verified_against: direction-named in-game POIs (Northern Beach gameX=-379k vs Southern Beach gameX=+397k) + dome landmark cross-checked on both imagery families (~1.5% agreement). Same linear formula shape as calibration.json - no axis flip.
_axis_note: Same convention as calibration.json: game X (Lat) spans [min_X,max_X] = 1234 along the image HEIGHT; game Y (Long) spans [min_Y,max_Y] = 1234 along the image WIDTH. Units: world cm / 1000.
_extent_note: This frame is LARGER than Vulnona's (X -607..509, Y -505..607): the SE archipelago (Hell's Mouth) is ON-image here because the islemaps art tracks a newer game build than Vulnona's 0.21.7 render. Per-source calibration is required; nothing may clamp.
_anchor_note: Same world-cm anchors as calibration.json, re-projected into the islemaps 2500px frame: px = (y/1000 + 560)/1234*2500, py = (x/1000 + 618)/1234*2500. Hell's Mouth is IN bounds under this calibration (py < 2500) - that is the sharpest regression test of the larger extent. The out-of-bounds record is synthetic: gameX = 700 units is past max_X = 616.

selftest_out_of_bounds.name: South of charted area (synthetic)
selftest_out_of_bounds.assert: py > image_height_px; must NOT be clamped
